evidence.planOrModel: Antigravity; official text is everyone's Gemini quota. Not a new subscription token table.

officialTerms.text: To mark a week of relentless shipping, we’re resetting everyone’s Gemini quota on Antigravity! Go build something amazing with swarms
officialTerms.kind: automatic global reset, not a banked/redeemable card
officialTerms.namedAllowances: Gemini quota only in this announcement. Unlike the 2026-11-06 post (2118855362518675720) which named Gemini and Argon, this post does not name Argon or Claude.
officialTerms.nov6AlreadyStaged: 2118855362518675720 is already known context for shengtang's 11-06 window comments; do not recount the Nov 6 reset as a new item.

corroboratingUserPosts.author: huang18825
corroboratingUserPosts.note: Official-looking Antigravity Usage popover after the reset: Gemini Models weekly 100% left and 5h 100% left; Claude and GPT weekly 44% left (resets in 2d 6h) and 5h 100% left. Oral: only Gemini was reset, Claude unchanged. No tokens, plan not labeled in the crop.

corroboratingUserPosts.author: keiba_assistant
corroboratingUserPosts.note: Japanese official-looking usage UI shortly after the announcement: Gemini weekly 100% / 5h 100%; Claude and GPT weekly 100% / 5h 100%; Gemini 4 Argon weekly 100%. No tokens. Later oral in another post says Gemini Pro license. Yesterday's keiba sample (Gemini weekly 12% used / 5h 18%) is a pre-reset snapshot and must not be spliced with this 100% post-reset screen.

corroboratingUserPosts.author: leo114119
corroboratingUserPosts.note: Screenshot is only the official _mohansolo tweet, not a usage console. Echo, not independent measurement.

evidence.conflictsToKeep: Official wording is Gemini quota, not Claude. huang18825's Claude weekly remaining 44% is consistent with Claude not being reset. Argon has a separate weekly meter; keiba shows Argon 100% after the reset, but the official tweet did not name Argon this time — do not treat that as a confirmed official Argon reset.
